responsibility: This header is the central low-level type nexus for GCC source files. It forward-declares the core IR, CFG, symtab, diagnostic, and mode types used throughout the compiler; defines globally shared enums and typedefs such as ir_type, alias_set_type, addr_space_t, symbol_visibility, and optimization-size levels; and then pulls in foundational mode, wide-int, alignment, and host-side utility headers. Its purpose is to let most GCC code name fundamental compiler data structures without needing full definitions up front.
